acceptance_tests.R2-01: R0 and R2 consume the identical common population, MG2m arm tensors, shared FIT-only scaler, masks, splits and seed; a changed population/scaler/design digest is refused
acceptance_tests.R2-02: R2 differs from R0 ONLY in the 19 branch initial weights: core and head initial weights bitwise equal to the R0 seed build, identical architecture/capacity (4882), branches trainable (never R1-frozen), end-to-end fine-tune with the R0 training recipe
acceptance_tests.R2-03: Donor import refuses shape-only matches: MG1, DS2/hourly/lagged, closed full-population, FS4 and I6-B branches (identical Conv1D kernel shapes) are refused by sampling rule, slot count, layer names, feature order, scaler digest, population digest, objective identity or weight digest
acceptance_tests.R2-04: Pretraining reads FIT windows only and selects on purged INNER only; DEVELOPMENT and TEST are never opened (perturbing DEVELOPMENT leaves donors bitwise unchanged)
acceptance_tests.R2-05: Targets stay RAW exact t+h prices; no reconstructed/denoised target or replacement input series reaches the fine-tune (input witness equal to R0's)
acceptance_tests.R2-06: The objective is ruled before execution: UNDECIDED_REQUIRES_REVIEW refuses execution (R2_OBJECTIVE_UNDECIDED); a ruled objective is a registered option with every parameter and fit setting fixed and a review reference; each donor records and must match it
acceptance_tests.R2-07: Reconstruction (or NOT_APPLICABLE) and the predictive probe are computed exactly as frozen, on purged INNER only, published as separate facts, never used to select R0/R2 and never claimed as utility or noise removal
acceptance_tests.R2-08: R0 reference is reused only when every R0_REUSE_COMPONENTS entry agrees AND the common R1 donor verifier accepts it; otherwise a fresh R0 fit is part of the graph; a full-population or MG1 fit is never R0; the R0 report is always recomputed
acceptance_tests.R2-09: Decision: equal-head mean of annual pooled relative MAE on the common DEVELOPMENT rows with each head's own naive; R2 selected iff score_R2 < score_R0 - 1e-8, ties retain R0; any failed head or arm closes INCOMPLETE_COMPARISON
acceptance_tests.R2-10: Pretraining loss/curves, pretraining compute, fine-tune FIT/INNER diagnostics and R0/R2 fit costs are separate OLAP facts with readback; one seed, no superiority claim
acceptance_tests.R2-11: Donor and R2-model serialization reload bitwise on CPU; bounded GPU replay under the declared numerical policy (no broadened tolerance)
acceptance_tests.R2-12: Scope: no core pretraining, cadence change, long family or TEST unit; any such field is refused (R2_SCOPE / TEST_FORBIDDEN)
acceptance_tests.R2-13: Donor provenance: each imported donor references this campaign's pretraining-unit stored terminal (authenticated) plus the learned-corpus digest (FIT windows and purged INNER selection rows), the objective ruling seal, the applied seed and the code pin; a forged or copied identity is refused (D3)
acceptance_tests.R2-14: Pretraining determinism: seed bound immediately before the decoder is built; no wall-clock budget stop selects a donor; bitwise-identical donor on CPU replay
acceptance_tests.R2-15: The ruled objective is executable by the registered component at validation time (D1)
acceptance_tests.R2-16: Decision integrity: decide_r2 requires scientific GPU fits and the R2 import record binding all 19 donor terminal digests, and refuses an import binding on R0 (D4)
acceptance_tests.R2-17: Automation (plan section 4) for the new graph: measured-peak admission class for pretraining units (1.25x its own peak, never the fit's); crash/restart, duplicate claim and outbox retry never repeat a completed pretraining or fit; status at every level; CLOSE with mirrors; a failed pretraining unit is a typed INCOMPLETE_COMPARISON, never an R0-only selection (OPS runner)
acceptance_tests.R2-18: R0 and R2 fits run on the same runtime and the same recorded GPU class; a difference is refused at decision time

decision.integrity: scientific GPU fits on the same runtime and GPU class; the R2 fit identity binds the import record (r2_import_sha256) whose 19 donor terminal digests are present; the R0 fit carries no import binding
decision.limits: one seed; DEVELOPMENT 2024 informed the feature set; no statistical superiority, holdout or trading eligibility claim
decision.rule: R2 selected iff score_R2 < score_R0 - 1e-8; otherwise R0 retained (no pretraining cost); any failed head or arm -> INCOMPLETE_COMPARISON
decision.score: equal-head mean of annual pooled (MAE_h-naive_h)/naive_h on the common DEVELOPMENT rows; each head keeps its own naive; negative is better

pretraining.budgets: max_updates and max_seconds fixed by the ruling; a budget stop is R2_PRETRAINING_BUDGET_STOP and the comparison closes INCOMPLETE_COMPARISON

data.purge: INNER windows whose earliest slot instant precedes the INNER start are excluded from selection (counted)

early_stopping.disclosure: INNER inputs (no labels) influence R2 twice and R0 once; DEVELOPMENT, the scoring split, is never touched

excluded_donors: any donor from another population, scaler, objective or arm

predictive.metric: per-head masked MAE ratio to naive and equal-head mean; probe_gain = R0-init probe minus pretrained probe
predictive.probe: frozen branches (pretrained vs R0 seed init) -> flatten 19x13x4 -> closed-form ridge per head, alpha 1.0, fitted on FIT common rows with the common masks in delta/naive_loss_scale coordinates

reconstruction.disclosure: reconstruction alone proves neither predictive utility nor noise removal
reconstruction.reference: zero (scaler-mean) reconstruction on the same windows

pretraining.inputs: arm_tensors(pop, EXPERIMENT.mg2m.json, split).x[:, :, f] scaled by pop.scaler (the identical MG2m slot windows of the common origins)
pretraining.provenance: DONORS_ONLY_FROM_THIS_CAMPAIGNS_AUTHENTICATED_PRETRAINING_TERMINALS: tools.i6dmo.model.write_branch_donor_terminal / load_branch_donor bind campaign, unit, applied seed, code pin, ruling seal, learned corpus, objective and donor bytes; a self-declared manifest never passes
pretraining.time_inputs: not branch inputs; the windows are the identical MG2m market slots, so support, calendar and time identity are the fine-tune's own
pretraining.unit_body: tools.i6dmo.model.pretrain_branch (seed bound immediately before the autoencoder is built; budget stop = typed failure, no donor)

question: On the selected MG2m input recipe, do compatible pretrained per-feature branch encoders, imported and fine-tuned (R2), improve on the matched R0 reference?

r0_reference.r1_verifier: the ONE common OPS donor verifier governing prepare and adoption (campaign.donor_fit_receipt_problem / donor_problem, matched_runner._check_donor, worker._adoptable) must return ACCEPT
r0_reference.report: the R0 report unit is always recomputed inside the R2 graph

selection.rule: lower equal-head mean annual pooled relative MAE; ties within 1e-8 retain cheaper MG2m

fit_pinning.gpu_class: R0 and R2 fits on the SAME recorded GPU class (receipt resources.gpu_device_names); scientific GPU fits only

shared.loss: equal-head masked MAE in delta/naive_loss_scale[h] coordinates (FIT-only naive)
shared.masks: population SplitPopulation.head_mask per split (common, never re-derived)

training.monitor: 0.5*(fit_loss+inner_loss) at the same end-of-epoch weights, computed ONLY through the shared inference evaluation path

monitor_comparison_floor.justification: a reproduced, build/context-specific numerical discrepancy between in-session and fresh-instance GPU executions of this pinned TensorFlow build (cause not demonstrated; eight mechanisms excluded: autotune/init order, TF32, weights, input bytes, forward identity, grappler remapping/layout/AMP; observed max 1.82e-5), bounded by the versioned NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT protocol i6dmo.monitor_numeric_equivalence.v2
monitor_comparison_floor.scope: cross-process GPU comparison of the monitored value and per-batch per-head float64 partial sums ONLY; CPU end-to-end, self-check, reload, predictions, input bytes, weight digests, forward identity and flags stay bitwise

training.restore: lowest monitored epoch, first tie wins
